scenario: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked very frightened. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person is now pulling at the victim’s hair and demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I shout loudly at the person, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
entities: I,the student bullying another student,the student being bullied
outcomes: The bully continues pulling the victim's hair
The bully continues demanding the victim's lunch money
The victim experiences physical pain from the hair pulling
The bully continues enjoying the harassment
